files.name: arms-x6
files.note: Six outrigger arms that stop the tray tipping.

files.name: drum-sleeve
files.note: Scoring-drum sleeve, in a second colour: slide it over the drum (pin up the slot) and twist. Labels show the drum colour through them.

files.name: feeder-baffles
files.note: Two baffles, printed flat. Drop them in from the top onto the ledges inside, lower one first.

files.name: feeder-roof
files.note: Closed lift-off roof. Prints upright on its eave strips; lips under its ends hug the gables.

files.name: feeder-tower
files.note: Birdfeeder body: back, sides and front in one piece. Prints upright, no supports.

files.name: fit-test-coupon
files.note: Print first: checks the key, countersink and screw fits.

files.name: hub
files.note: Printed top-down. 5 walls or 40% infill (screws bite into it).

files.name: insert-cards-plain
files.note: Swappable: four open bins for games without hummingbirds.

files.name: keys-x8
files.note: Eight bowtie keys that join the quarters.

files.name: quarter-cards
files.note: Hummingbird draw deck and discard wells (bird-card stands out for now). Floor down.

files.name: quarter-decks
files.note: Deck and discard wells. Floor down.

files.name: quarter-feeder
files.note: Birdfeeder dish and rolling area. Floor down.

files.name: quarter-food-eggs
files.note: Food bins and egg bin. Floor down.

files.name: scoring-drum-body-only
files.note: Multi-material printers only: the drum without its lift, in the same position as the lift-only file. Load both as one object to print the lift in its own colour.

files.name: scoring-drum-lift-only
files.note: Multi-material printers only: the lift by itself, positioned to drop into the body-only file.

files.name: scoring-drum
files.note: Centre piece: inner scoring drum with goal-tile slots and a captive tile lift printed in place (push the tab down once to free it). One colour on a single-nozzle printer; for two, use the body-only and lift-only files. Pairs with the drum sleeve.

hardware: Quarters to hub (8) and arms to base (12). Sold in 100-packs.
Bearing to hub and base: one per bearing hole.
Rubber bumper feet, 12 mm or smaller
